messages:
maria: FYI a customer reported 415 on Cloudflare Workers after upgrading to SDK 0.9.0. Happens when the SDK retries auth requests. Any quick ideas?

sahil: Saw this in a flaky e2e. Workers treat Headers differently; our retry clones + appends auth and ends up with duplicate Authorization.

ben: Quick repro I used:
```js
addEventListener('fetch', e => {
  const r = new Request(e.request);
  r.headers.append('authorization', e.request.headers.get('authorization'));
  fetch(r);
});
```
That caused some origins to return 415.

maria: Customer uses NGINX + auth proxy; it rejects duplicate auth headers. Node normalized it so it passed before.

karen: Right — append() can create multiple header values in Workers; some proxies reject that.

maria: Our retry code sets Authorization twice (in cloned Request and in fetch init). Root cause.

sahil: Quick fix: when retrying, create a new Request and set headers via headers.set instead of append. Also avoid passing headers in both Request and init.

ben: Also found a typing leak: ESM build pulled in node types (import type from 'stream'), forcing consumers on Workers to get node defs. For edge we should expose web types only.

maria: Plan: add edge entry in package.json exports and a tsconfig.edge with libs ["webworker","es2021"]. Add runtime feature detection for fetch/ReadableStream.

karen: Add a tiny sample under samples/edge-auth-repro (Miniflare) and a lint rule forbidding headers.append('authorization', ...) in retry codepaths.

sahil: I'll open a PR with: (1) safe retry impl, (2) edge tsconfig + export, (3) sample + tests.

ci-bot: Created RN-4321: "CF Workers: avoid duplicate Authorization on retries; add edge export + typing fix" https://git.internal/redwood/rn/4321

maria: Thanks, assigned to @sahil. Ping when the sample is up. :thumbsup:
